snippet.title: Tayutama: It's Happy Days - Official English PV
snippet.description:
Wishlist  "Tayutama: It's Happy Days" on Steam!
"Tayutama: It's Happy Days" is the fan disc follow-up to "Tayutama: Kiss on my Deity," originally developed by Lump of Sugar.

Like the first game, "Tayutama: It's Happy Days" will be a HD remaster available in English, Japanese, Traditional Chinese and Simplified Chinese.
We are also planning an official patch.
